subject: Synergia: request for bundled onboarding + premium support concession
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@synergia.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@synergia.ai
Date: 2027-10-10T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging request: include Premium Support + 3 connectors (SOW v3 attached)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Synergia's launch team is excited about Redwood's latency/cost profile. We've reviewed the draft SOW (attached) and need to lock two commercial concessions to meet our go-live target (Nov 15):

- Include Premium Support (24x7, P1 1-hour response) for the first 12 months as part of the initial package;
- Build and deliver three bespoke data connectors (EHR, internal LIMS, and an S3-mirroring pipeline) as part of onboarding.

Given the expanded scope we are asking for a one-off 25% reduction on ProServices fees and a 30% credit against the first month's usage to offset ramp cost. If Redwood can commit to those, procurement will sign within 72 hours. We attached SOW v3 and a proposed M.A.P. with milestone dates.

Can you confirm feasibility and provide a Deal Desk escalation if required? Tight timing on our side, so we'd appreciate a turnaround by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Synergia Therapeutics
[Attachment: Synergia_SOW_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@synergia.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-10T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging request: include Premium Support + 3 connectors (SOW v3 attached)

Anna — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I'll route this to Deal Desk and ProServices for scope and commercial review.

Quick notes from my side:
- Premium Support can be included, but the 24x7 SLA and P1 objective will require an onboarding validation window and an operational runbook sign-off.
- The three custom connectors are non-standard engineering work; we typically treat that as billable deliverables in the SOW or as a fixed-cost engineering addendum.

Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (head of ProServices) to model options. We'll aim to get back with recommended concessions and a redline to the SOW by EOD tomorrow.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[MAP attached: MAP_Synergia_v2.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-11T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Synergia packaging request — preliminary deal desk analysis

Team — ran numbers and sketched concessions. See attached financial impact calc. TL;DR: the requested 25% off ProServices + 30% first-month usage credit is ~USD 112k impact in year 1 (combined).

Options I'm putting forward for exec approval:
1) Approve with guardrails (recommended): 20% ProServices discount (one-time), include Premium Support at standard annual price but waive the $25k onboarding fee by applying a 50% credit to month 1 usage; require 30% non-refundable up-front to cover custom engineering mobilization.
2) Conservative: 15% discount, charge onboarding fee in full, treat connectors as separate SOWs.
3) Aggressive: full ask (25% + 30% credit). Approve only if Exec signs off to protect renewal economics.

Key risks: custom connector engineering (est. 6-10 engineer-weeks) and timeline slippage could push launch beyond Nov 15; revenue deferral and increased first-year churn pressure.

Attachments: Synergia_fin_impact_calc.xlsx
Action: need Exec sign-off on the recommended option (1) or explicit approval of option 3. Please advise if we need Legal to redline SOW now.

-ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations
[Attachment: Synergia_fin_impact_calc.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Synergia packaging request — proservices scope & SOW considerations

Agree with Ben's recommended approach (Option 1) with the following conditions we should make explicit in the SOW:
- Deliverables: three connectors as defined in SOW Annex A with acceptance criteria; delivery milestones tied to payment (30% up-front, 40% on delivery of connectors, 30% on production verification).
- Time & materials cap: fixed-fee per connector; any scope creep requires a change order.
- Premium Support: include for 12 months, but operational SLA benefits begin after a 2-week validation period post-acceptance.
- Credits: onboarding credit limited to month 1 only, applied as a usage credit; not refundable.

I recommend we escalate to Executive for an exception to standard discount caps because this is high strategic value (platform reference + expected expansion). Please ask for Exec approval to grant 20% ProServices discount + 50% onboarding fee credit (equivalent to Ben's Option 1), and require DocuSign within 48 hours once approved.

Marissa
Director, Professional Services
Redwood Inference
[Internal SOW redline ready — will attach once Legal okays]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-13T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: Synergia — 20% ProServices discount + onboarding concession (time-sensitive)

Rishi — quick ask for executive approval. Synergia (prospect) is asking for a bundled deal that includes:
- Premium Support (12 months) included in initial term;
- Three custom connectors as part of onboarding (fixed-fee deliverables in SOW);
- Commercial concession: 20% discount on ProServices (one-time) + apply a 50% credit vs. onboarding fee (applied as month 1 usage credit).

Why approve:
- Strategic: prospect is a strong platform reference in our target vertical and will run high-volume inference;
- Timing: procurement requires commercial terms locked to meet a Nov 15 go-live;
- Risk mitigations: SOW will include milestone-based payments, scope caps per connector, and a 30% non-refundable mobilization payment.

Financial impact: ~USD 85-112k NRR erosion in year 1 depending on exact usage; covered in Ben's calc.

Decision requested: Please reply-all with either "Approve: 20% + 50% credit (DocuSign within 48h)" or "Decline". Remaining items (legal redline, SOW milestones) will be completed by Marissa once we have your sign-off.

Thanks,
Olga

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: Synergia — 20% ProServices discount + onboarding concession (time-sensitive)

Approve: 18% ProServices discount + onboarding concession as outlined, conditional on the following (must be included in SOW):
- 30% non-refundable mobilization payment before dev kickoff;
- Fixed-fee per connector with a hard cap and change-order process;
- DocuSign executed within 48 hours of our send — otherwise approval lapses.

Reasoning: keep some conservatism on discount while moving quickly for the strategic win. Ben/Marissa — please update the HubSpot deal and push the DocuSign envelope once redlines are done. Olga — confirm back to Synergia and request procurement to sign within the 48h window.

-rishi
Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
